aggregation: Equal clocks within symbol/week, equal2weeks within block, equal6symbols per context; joint calendar blocks only. Never count M5 bars as independent sample units.
carrier: sign(last completed M5 log increment), fixed without outcome selection. Both continuation and reversal are one two-sided family.
clock: Every eligible completed M5 bar, not a rare trigger. CSV time_utc is start; close available +300s. Require every past and future timestamp; no filling.
closure: Support fail=DATA_LIMITED_UNTESTED_NOT_NULL. Calibration fail=CALIBRATION_UNCERTIFIED_UNTESTED_NOT_NULL. Power gate fail=LOW_POWER_INCONCLUSIVE_NO_RESPONSE. No lead after opening=NO_REPLICATED_INFORMATION_LEAD_SMALL_EFFECTS_LOW_POWER_INCONCLUSIVE. Exact design only, broader variance family remains open.
economic_boundary: COST_UNRESOLVED. Require authentic conservative historical spread, commission, slippage, EUR conversion, broker sizing and margin before any promotion. No assumed zero costs. HARD21 final portfolio certification only.
execution_translation: Later single-leg own instrument sign(theta*x_residual), with fixed1h exit, costs-aware sizing and nonoverlap position policy. Reading context is not executing hedge. Statistical theta direction may be retained only under predeclared two-sided lead rule. No executable strategy or profit claim now.
feature: Q=sum(r_i^4)/(sum(r_i^2)^2) for last12 M5 log increments. Concentration of realized variance across increments; invariant to individual signs and ordering. No RV>0 means feature undefined, reported as missing. Q is not a jump estimator.
independent_unit: Nonoverlapping two-week context vectors, shared calendar across all3contexts. Short-memory approximately stationary scores assumption; residual interblock dependence allowed in HAC2; no arbitrary-dependence guarantee.

inference.family: 3contexts, one horizon, both signs; conservative fixed cutoff, no estimated pvalue or nominal analytical FWER claim
inference.mc_rule: Every32 null-case/block-count upper Wilson bound<=.05; z3.163 is conservative Bonferroni simultaneous95% two-sided allocation. 4096trials selected before simulation: upper half-width around2% error below0.01. No seed/trial/threshold retuning.
inference.power_law: Complete significance + same sign all3contexts + all3 temporal thirds +4of6symbols per context. Effect in SD of two-week context score, not bps. Require normal and mild serial dependence lower95%>=.8 at2SD in weakest18block geometry. Report weaker effects as LOW_POWER_INCONCLUSIVE; strong AR power remains diagnostic.
inference.statistic: mean/HAC Bartlett lag2 SE on two-week scores

interaction: raw=c*(Q-prefix meanQ); prefix residual against controls [1,c,c*clip(log(RV/prefix medianRV),-4,4),c*sin(UTC day phase),c*cos(UTC day phase)]; divide by prefix residual RMS.
period_policy: 42 complete weeks, fixed evaluation anchor2025-11-17 through2026-09-06 inclusive. Remaining incomplete two-week tail is prospectively excluded for calendar geometry, not performance. Every available qualifying block retained; no best-period subset.
prior_exposure: Accepted development population previously used, not pristine independent confirmation. No prior effect, pvalue, sign, eventcount used for selection; genuinely disjoint time/identity confirmation mandatory and unauthorized.
replication: Same nonzero direction and absT>=5 in ALL3 contexts; same direction every fixed calendar third(b//7); at least4of6 assets each context. No pooling/bestcontext lead.
response: x_residual*(own next1h log return/prefix hourly RMS - prefix OLS baseline_y). Information score incremental to frozen carrier/variance amplitude/UTC carrier baseline; no hedge. No claim of incremental information against every alternative model.
training: All eligible prefix M5 clocks with all prefix-contained next12 timestamps; OLS only prefix. Future prefix prices allowed for baseline training only; entire prefix disjoint and purged from development. Feature, response scaling and nuisance coefficients never refitted in development.
